mapper.select: SELECT t.id FROM kit_job_registry AS t WHERE t.modify_time < DATE_ADD(#{nowTime}, INTERVAL -#{timeout} SECOND)
SELECT t.id FROM kit_job_registry AS t WHERE t.modify_time < (#{nowTime} - INTERVAL '1 second' * #{timeout})
SELECT t.id, t.registry_group, t.registry_key, t.registry_value, t.modify_time FROM kit_job_registry AS t WHERE t.modify_time > DATE_ADD(#{nowTime}, INTERVAL -#{timeout} SECOND)
SELECT t.id, t.registry_group, t.registry_key, t.registry_value, t.modify_time FROM kit_job_registry AS t WHERE t.modify_time > (#{nowTime} - INTERVAL '1 second' * #{timeout})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kit_job_registry (id, registry_group, registry_key, registry_value, modify_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{registryGroup}, #{registryKey}, #{registryValue}, #{modifyTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE modify_time = #{modifyTime}

INSERT INTO kit_job_registry (id, registry_group, registry_key, registry_value, modify_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{registryGroup}, #{registryKey}, #{registryValue}, #{modifyTime}) ON CONFLICT (registry_group, registry_key, registry_value) DO UPDATE SET modify_time = #{modifyTime}
